content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has issued an examination notification for UPSSSC 20 Exam 2026.

Post-wise vacancy, eligibility, age limit, application dates and fee details should be checked in the official notification PDF before applying.

How to Apply

  1. Download and read the official notification.
  2. Open the official UPSSSC application portal.
  3. Complete registration and enter the required details.
  4. Upload documents, pay the fee if applicable and submit the form.
  5. Keep a printout of the final application.
editorNotes: This listing is based on the supplied notification PDF. Verify the latest details on the official UPSSSC website before applying.
